title: 第7章 徒儿的日常脑补第8章 如果师父看到其实也没什么
slug: 我的徒弟们都太逆天了
lines: “你将荣华富贵一生，后宫佳丽三千人，也算是尽享俗世之乐。”
宗主的声音如同天籁之音。
陆玄愣住了。
卧槽？
其实这样也行啊！
后宫佳丽三千，想想就轻而易举。
宗主皱眉，“你笑什么？”
陆玄道，“乐不思蜀。”
宗主微微摇头，暗自叹息。
果然朽木不可雕也！
陆玄没救了。
宗主继续说道，“算了。这个月就让你瞎折腾吧，也让扶摇多走一个月弯路，让她明白一个好师父的重要。”
“一个月后，姬扶摇如果没有得到内门比试第一，就让她离开青玄峰吧。如何？”
陆玄笑了笑，“如果是第一呢？”
宗主摇头，“这不可能！”
且不说那些顶尖真传弟子，就是那些顶尖的内门弟子，姬扶摇恐怕也不是对手。
要知道这一次内门比试，最强的弟子已经踏入玄宗境后期大圆满了！
姬扶摇只是大玄王，拿什么比？
这中间可是差了两个大境界！
宗主拍了拍陆玄的肩膀，不在多言，收起玉玺，直接离开了。
不多时。
宗主来到大道殿找到幕老，将方才姬扶摇洗碗的事情说了一遍。
幕老目瞪口呆，“竟有此事？”
宗主连连摇头道，“我也不知道为何姬扶摇对陆玄这么尊敬？”
幕老微微皱眉，浑浊的目光望向青玄峰的方向，突然问道，“你觉得陆玄难道一直在隐藏自己？”
宗主哑然失笑道，“不可能！绝对不可能！”
幕老沉默了。
说的也是。
陆玄他懂个劳什子的教徒弟啊！
宗主道，“也罢。我探查到，姬扶摇现在已经是大玄王后期大圆满了。”
幕老脸上堆满了皱纹，如同沟壑一般，有些惊异，“难道入宗考核的时候，扶摇隐藏了修为，这才是她真正的境界？”
宗主笑了笑，“大概是了。”
幕老抚须，脸色有些凝重，“这丫头身上是有秘密的。不过我大道宗从来不惧所谓的秘密。”
“现在扶摇已经立下了天道誓言，已经是我大道宗的一员！”
“这些秘密我大道宗不仅不会窥探，还会为她守住。”
宗主点了点头，“不错。”
青玄峰。
姬扶摇早已回到洞府，继续修炼。
一方面炼化蛟龙肉，一方面吸收上品灵石。
海量的灵能在她的四周狂涌，形成了一个小风暴。
content_en:
"You will live a lifetime of glory and wealth, with a harem of three thousand beauties, and you can enjoy all the happiness in the world."
The sect master's voice was like the sound of nature.
Lu Xuan was stunned.
Damn it?
In fact, this is also okay!
It is easy to think about the three thousand beauties in the harem.
The sect master frowned, "Why are you laughing?"
Lu Xuandao said, "I don't want to miss Shu anymore."
The sect leader shook his head slightly and sighed secretly.
Sure enough, rotten wood cannot be carved!
Lu Xuan was hopeless.
The sect leader continued, "Forget it. I'll let you mess around this month, and let Fuyao go through detours for an extra month to let her understand the importance of a good master."
"In one month, if Ji Fuyao doesn't get the first place in the inner sect competition, let her leave Qingxuan Peak. How about that?"
Lu Xuan smiled, "What if it's number one?"
The sect master shook his head, "This is impossible!"
Not to mention the top true disciples, even the top inner disciples, Ji Fuyao might not be a match.
You must know that in this inner sect competition, the strongest disciple has already entered the late Xuanzong realm and reached the Great Consummation!
Ji Fuyao is just the Great Xuan King, so what can he compare to him?
There are two big differences between them!
The sect leader patted Lu Xuan on the shoulder, said nothing, put away the jade seal, and left directly.
Not long after.
The sect leader came to the Daodao Hall to find Mr. Mu and told Ji Fuyao about washing the dishes just now.
Mr. Mu was stunned, "Is this happening?"
The sect leader shook his head repeatedly and said, "I don't know why Ji Fuyao respects Lu Xuan so much?"
Mr. Mu frowned slightly, looked in the direction of Qingxuan Peak with turbid eyes, and suddenly asked, "Do you think Lu Xuan has been hiding himself?"
The sect master laughed dumbly and said, "Impossible! Absolutely impossible!"
Mr. Mu was silent.
That's right.
Lu Xuan knows how to be a troublesome disciple!
The sect leader said, "That's fine. I found out that Ji Fuyao is now in the late stage of the Great Xuan King's Great Consummation."
Elder Mu's face was full of wrinkles, like ravines, and he was a little surprised, "Did Fuyao hide her cultivation during the sect entrance examination? Is this her true state?"
The sect master smiled and said, "Probably so."
Mr. Mu stroked his beard and looked a little solemn, "There is a secret in this girl. But our Dao Sect has never been afraid of so-called secrets."
"Now Fuyao has taken the Heavenly Dao Oath and is already a member of our Daodao Sect!"
"Not only will our Dao Sect not pry into these secrets, we will also keep them for her."
The sect leader nodded, "Not bad."
…
Qingxuan Peak.
Ji Fuyao has already returned to the cave and continues to practice.
On the one hand, he refines the dragon meat, and on the other hand, he absorbs high-grade spiritual stones.
A large amount of spiritual energy surged around her, forming a small storm.
